title: Perception and attention
summary: The six walkthroughs of an open-source 3D brain guide explain routes for vision, touch, hearing and speech, feedback from the cortex to the thalamus, and attention networks. The 2D figures end with a draggable normalization model showing how priority for one sense reduces the others.

source.label: Juan Bermudez, Perception & Attention (open source, MIT), 2026
